prose: Meta raised $15 billion in a US dollar bond sale, per Bloomberg, with sources saying orders reached as much as $58 billion. It is the largest part of a $20 billion-plus cross-border offering, as Meta becomes the latest Big Tech company to borrow heavily.
highlights: Meta sold $15B of USD bonds; orders up to $58B per sources
Biggest part of a $20B+ cross-border offering
